name: How long does a home renovation project usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a home renovation project usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a home renovation project depends heavily on its size and complexity. A small project, such as a bathroom refresh, might take 3-6 weeks. A complete kitchen remodel could extend from 6-12 weeks, while a multi-room or whole-home renovation can take 3-6 months or even longer. Permitting processes, material lead times, and unforeseen structural issues can also impact the timeline. Your contractor will provide a detailed schedule outlining key milestones.
acceptedAnswer.description: Renovation timelines vary by project size; a small bathroom might take 3-6 weeks, while a full kitchen could be 6-12 weeks, and whole-home remodels longer.
